body:

- Blockers / risks: none. Owner/successor to push 931f6f1c7 + bb80c1c7c. WS4 (Geyser: substrate-credibility/commit-concurrency/M2 + review; Kayak: liveness/coordination/emergent) resumes on owner's go.
